summary: Let an evidence note cover a run whose declared inputs are identical, still in shadow: no check enforces yet

schema.detail: No daemon claim or portable record change.

rules.detail: The evidence verifier can match a signed note of another tree when the tree reduced to a check's declared paths is the same, and the gate can sample such a match. Every check keeps enforce false, so no job is skipped by this change; the gate only prints what it would do. The aggregate linux-gate now accepts a skipped stage only when that stage's own skip rule says skip, and the gate also protects the workflow helper module and the two evidence tests.

compatibility.detail: The gate may fetch refs under refs/notes/evidence-input after a declared-inputs check; with none present it behaves as before.

manual.detail: The central evidence workflow pin needs its usual rotation because fleet.yml changed.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous workflow; no state is written.
